name: Oman (1970–1995)
description: A red vertical stripe at the hoist bearing the white national emblem of crossed swords and a khanjar in the upper corner, and a fly of three horizontal stripes of white, red and green in the ratio 2:1:2.
history: The first flag of Oman, introduced by royal decree of 17 December 1970 after Sultan Qaboos bin Said deposed his father and replaced the plain red banner of Muscat and Oman. In this version the central red stripe of the fly was narrower than the white and green. On 25 April 1995 the three stripes were made equal and the proportions changed to 1:2.
